title: The Island That Takes Turns

script.text: Every six months, this island changes countries.

script: It sits in the Bidasoa river, right on the border between France and Spain.

script.text: In [1659|sixteen fifty-nine], the two kingdoms signed a peace treaty here.

script: A year later, a Spanish princess crossed it to marry [Louis XIV|Louis the Fourteenth].
The treaty made it shared land, owned by both.

script.text: And since [1856|eighteen fifty-six], they take turns running it.

script: At each handover, naval officers from both sides meet to swap the paperwork.

script.text: The rest of the time, it's closed. Nobody lives there.
Its total area? Just [6,820|six thousand, eight hundred and twenty] square meters.
The smallest piece of land on Earth shared by two countries.

script: Wait six months, and it changes hands again.
